meta.name: azure-quotas
meta.description: Check/manage Azure quotas and usage across providers. For deployment planning, capacity validation, region selection. WHEN: "check quotas", "service limits", "current usage", "request quota increase", "quota exceeded", "validate capacity", "regional availability", "provisioning limits", "vCPU limit", "how many vCPUs available in my subscription".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查和管理 Azure 配额与使用量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理 Azure 配额确保资源可用
copy.tagline_en: Check and manage Azure quotas and usage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage Azure quotas to ensure resource availability

howto.what: Claude 会查你 Azure 订阅的配额：返回各资源上限、当前用量和剩余可用量（如 vCPU），可对比多个区域的空余，并提交配额提升申请。结果以表格或数字呈现，用来判断能否部署或选哪个区域。
howto.when: 当对话里出现“查配额”“配额超了”“申请提高配额”等说法，或你想比较区域容量、验证部署容量时触发。

say.text: 看看 eastus 的 vCPU 配额和已用多少？
say.note: 返回 core 限制、用量和剩余。

say.text: 配额不足，把 Microsoft.Compute 的 cores 提到 500。
say.note: 会提交提额请求并告知审批状态。

say.text: 对比 eastus 和 westus2 哪里还能部署更多 VM？
say.note: 会列出两区域可用容量。

howto.what_en: Claude queries Azure quotas, returning each resource's limit, usage, and available capacity, comparing capacity across regions, and submitting quota increase requests when asked. Output appears as a table or numbers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users mention checking quotas, current usage, or quota exceeded, or ask to request a quota increase, validate capacity, or compare regions.

say_en.text: Check vCPU quota and usage in eastus for me.
say_en.note: Returns core limit, usage, and remaining capacity.

say_en.text: My quota is insufficient; raise Microsoft.Compute cores quota to 500.
say_en.note: Submits the increase request and shows status.

say_en.text: Compare eastus and westus2 — where can I deploy more VMs?
say_en.note: Shows available capacity in both regions.
